# Synthetic fixtures

All fixtures in this directory are SYNTHETIC. probe_vfr.json is invented ffprobe
metadata used to test PTS fallback and sampling-index separation. It is not a SAM
response, recorded hardware video or evidence of a real action.

Mask rasters are generated in the unit tests. Integration videos are generated by
ffmpeg in test temporary directories. The separately attributed codec vector in
scripts/check_sam_contract.py is a documented synthetic example, not a retained
provider response. Real responses must never be placed here with synthetic labels.
